# compute_lookup_array_gop {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
compute_lookup_array_gop()
```
Compute the `3×3×3` lookup array that maps a competition-ranking vector (see [`competerank!`](competerank!.qmd)) of length 3 to the index (1–13) of the corresponding generalized ordinal pattern (GOP); see Equations (2) and (4) in Weiß and Schnurr (2024).
 


:::
